attributes.context: The fragment appears before the agreement’s later management-rights provision on separating technicians and before Article 5 employee rights, indicating it is part of a management-rights or consultation list in the Michigan Adjutant General–LIUNA agreement.

Located in Article 18, Employee Development and Training, Section 18.1, Job Related Training and Qualifications, which also provides that the Employer will provide job related training subject to funding and will consider the Union's views in developing training programs.

extraction_text: The Parties recognize that changes in the work place will continue as technology, new techniques, material, and equipment are developed and employed. Each Employee is responsible for taking the initiative necessary to keep abreast of these changes.
